summary: Timeboxed approval to access redacted model-routing decision traces and minimal streaming KV updates for compliance review
description:
Issue summary: Compliance requests a scoped review of model-routing decision traces and a minimal set of streaming KV update events to validate a suspected routing anomaly that may have affected customer request handling.
Justification: Compliance needs evidence that routing policies and fallback heuristics operated within documented SLAs during a payment reconciliation window.
Scope:
- Only routing decision traces (fields: request_id, timestamp, model_id, route_version, decision_reason, latency_ms)
- Minimal streaming KV update events limited to metadata keys (key names only; values redacted)
- NO raw customer inputs, NO full output tokens, NO PII.
Duration: 48 hours access window to perform queries and collect redacted exports.
Data minimization controls: exporter will redact all request/response payloads, strip token-level outputs, and obfuscate any identifiers besides request_id.
Access controls: dual approval required (Security + Compliance); access via KMS-wrapped temporary credentials; exporter runs in read-only mode from a secured diagnostics job; all actions logged to audit-index-ops.
Retention and handoff: exported artifacts kept in secured S3 bucket with 30-day retention, encrypted with customer-managed KMS key.
Approvals required: Security (data minimization verification), Legal (if external sharing is anticipated), Compliance owner sign-off.
Steps for extract:
1) SRE to run bounded query via exporters/replay-utils with redact=true.
2) Security to verify output sample (first 50 rows) in staging-only preview.
3) On approval, full timeboxed export to KMS-protected bucket.
Risk mitigation: deny any requests that contain raw payloads; sampling only when necessary; maintain full audit trail with justification.
Next steps requested from approvers:
- Security: confirm redaction regex and sampling plan
- Compliance: confirm fields required for their review
- SRE (assignee): prepare extraction job and estimated runtime (ETA: 24h)
